messages:
anya: FYI observed steady KV memory creep on 60k-token runs. RSS climbs ~700MB/hr even with same request mix. heap profile points to many small live fragments in slabs; free_small keeps shrinking.

mike: can you drop the kv dump and the bench command you used?

anya: pasted below (prod-ish snapshot + local micro-bench):
```
kv_overview: slabs=192 shards=48
small_block=192 large_block=4096
allocated_small=51234 free_small=1482 small_free_ratio=0.028
allocated_large=612 free_large=392 frag_index=0.61
compactions=4 compaction_cpu_ms=1200 last_compact=1769009000
```
local repro: `./tools/bench/kv_frag_test --seq=60000 --reuse_prob=0.3 --threads=12`
output tail:
```
iter 900 mem_rss=7.4G kv_alloc=5.8G small_free_ratio=0.025
iter 1800 mem_rss=8.2G kv_alloc=6.5G small_free_ratio=0.019
```

jess: frag_index 0.61 is pretty bad. Did we tweak the allocation slope or block partitioning recently? I recall a change to favor micro-allocs for <1k runs a while back.

anya: yep we bumped global_slope -> 0.72 last quarter to cut short-context tail latency. It improved p50 but may have made small-block consolidation rarer for long contexts.

zach: compaction currently triggers if small_free_ratio < 0.008, and relocate runs are large which cause jitter. We should try an incremental approach: earlier lighter coalescing pass that only merges free neighbors, then limited relocates.

leo: idea: dynamically increase small_block size for slabs that see lots of long-context keys. e.g., hot slabs switch small_block=384 or 512. That reduces fragmentation overhead for those slabs.

jess: sketch plan:
- lower compaction trigger to small_free_ratio < 0.06 for nodes serving longctx traffic
- introduce coalesce-only pass with budget ops_per_tick=96
- per-shard slope override: default 0.72, longctx-hot shards 0.58
- constrained relocate budget: relocate_bytes_per_tick=48KB

mike: latency risk from relocate is real. We should measure p99_token before/after and gate rollout on small p99 delta.

anya: implemented a prototype locally with those knobs. Ran 45m bench. summary:
```
baseline: mem_growth ~720MB/hr small_free_ratio~0.02 frag_index 0.60 p99_token=82ms
coalesce-only + slope=0.58 on hot shards: mem_growth ~140MB/hr small_free_ratio~0.11 frag_index 0.24 p99_token=84ms (+2ms)
coalesce+limited-relocate: mem_growth ~40MB/hr small_free_ratio~0.18 frag_index 0.11 p99_token=100ms (+18ms)
```

jess: good signal. coalesce seems to be the sweet spot for longctx with minimal p99 impact. relocate helps further but costs too much p99.

zach: rollout suggestion:
1) Canary two non-prod pools with per-shard slope + coalesce only for 24h. collect frag_index, small_free_ratio, compaction_cpu_ms, p99_token.
2) If p99_token delta < +5ms and frag_index drops >=30% -> expand to more nodes and run chat-corpus eval.
3) If stable, enable for longctx routing in prod.

mike: I'll wire an automated bench to run after deploy. Proposed commands:
```
./infra/deploy-canary --image=kv-compactor:pr-123 --nodes=2 --flags "slope_override=0.58,coalesce_ops=96,relocate_budget=48KB,compact_trigger=0.06"
./tools/bench/kv_frag_test --longctx --check-p99 --out=canary_out.json
```

anya: opening a short RFC and a PR for coalesce-only change first. I'll add metrics: coalesce_ops, coalesce_ms, relocate_ops, relocate_ms, frag_index, small_free_ratio. Also adding env opt-out flag for Dedicated customers.

leo: please ensure compactor respects CPU QoS and disables heavy ops under sustained CPU pressure. We should back off if rps or p99 rises.

jess: also run an eval on a real multi-user chat corpus; synth bench may not capture reuse locality.

anya: noted. Will include a 24h trace from our chat-eval set in the PR and the perf dashboard. tagging @jess @zach for review. Thanks all :thumbsup:
